Attempt to read the '/etc/passwd' file using \lstinputlisting{/etc/passwd} failed, returning an empty response. 3. The site is expected to be adding $ before and after the input for in-line mode. Breaking out of this by adding $ before and after the command, like $\lstinputlisting{/etc/passwd}$, worked. 4.
